mapper.select: SELECT N.NOTICE_NUMBER AS noticeNumber, NULL AS noticeCode, N.NOTICE_TITLE AS noticeTitle, N.NOTICE_CONTENT AS noticeContent, N.NOTICE__DATE AS noticeDate, NVL(N.VIEWS, 0) AS views, N.NOTICE_CATEGORY AS noticeCategory, N.NOTICE_AUTHOR AS employeeCode FROM ADMIN_NOTICE N WHERE N.NOTICE_NUMBER = #{noticeNumber}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT N.NOTICE_NUMBER AS noticeNumber, NULL AS noticeCode, N.NOTICE_TITLE AS noticeTitle, N.NOTICE_CONTENT AS noticeContent, N.NOTICE__DATE AS noticeDate, NVL(N.VIEWS, 0) AS views, N.NOTICE_CATEGORY AS noticeCategory, N.NOTICE_AUTHOR AS employeeCode FROM ADMIN_NOTICE N WHERE N.NOTICE_NUMBER < #{noticeNumber} ORDER BY N.NOTICE_NUMBER DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT N.NOTICE_NUMBER AS noticeNumber, NULL AS noticeCode, N.NOTICE_TITLE AS noticeTitle, N.NOTICE_CONTENT AS noticeContent, N.NOTICE__DATE AS noticeDate, NVL(N.VIEWS, 0) AS views, N.NOTICE_CATEGORY AS noticeCategory, N.NOTICE_AUTHOR AS employeeCode FROM ADMIN_NOTICE N WHERE N.NOTICE_NUMBER > #{noticeNumber} ORDER BY N.NOTICE_NUMBER ASC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
